\begin{aligned}u&=2 x - 1\\ \frac{\text{d}u}{\text{d}x}&=2\\ \text{d}u&=2\,\text{d}x\\ \frac{1}{2}\text{d}u&=1\,\text{d}x\end{aligned}
$$

$$
\begin{aligned}x & 1 & 2\\ u & 1 & 3\end{aligned}
$$

$$
\int_{1}^{2} \sqrt{2 x - 1}\,\text{d}x=\int_{1}^{3} \sqrt{u}\cdot (\frac{1}{2})\,\text{d}u.

$$
